usageNotes: Retrieves the list of vCPUs visible to the guest OS via the QEMU Guest Agent (QGA); use this to verify CPU hot-plug operations have taken effect inside the VM. The QEMU Guest Agent must be installed and running inside the guest, and the VM must be in a powered-on state, otherwise the call will fail. Requires either VM.GuestAgent.Audit or VM.GuestAgent.Unrestricted on /vms/{vmid}.

examples.summary: Get vCPU list for VM 105 on node pve1

tips: If the guest agent is not running, the API returns an error rather than an empty result — check agent status with get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_agent_get_osinfo first.
The returned vCPU list reflects the guest OS perspective, which may differ from the host-configured vCPU count if hot-plug changes have not yet been acknowledged by the guest.
CPU online/offline state per vCPU is included in the result; useful for confirming that CPU hot-add actually brought a new vCPU online inside the guest.
